answer:
Use the `-j` or `--max-concurrency` flag with `promptfoo eval`. The docs describe it as "Maximum number of concurrent API calls" [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md].

Example from the OSWorld guide, which runs with one concurrent call:

"--filter-metadata app=libreoffice_calc --max-concurrency 1 \" [promptfoo/site/docs/guides/evaluate-osworld-with-inspect.md]

The same flag also works with `promptfoo redteam run` [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]. For `promptfoo retry`, the option is spelled `--max-concurrency <number>` and limits "concurrent evals" rather than API calls [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md].

I don't know from these excerpts whether a config-file setting for concurrency exists, so the CLI flag is the option I can confirm.
